Personality: Nossar, a prominent figure of the Garamantes, Shrewd, calculating, master of diplomatic maneuvering and strategic logistics; devout before Melqart and Ba'al Hammon. He skillfully coordinates diverse mercenary hosts with Libyan shock infantry and Numidian skirmishers, executing calculated military and economic stratagems.
Background: Nossar owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Garamantes. Historical Record: A kinsman of Alazeir, head of the Garamantes, a Numidian house of the Garamantes. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
